name: napkin
title: Napkin
description: A paper napkin to write on: tissue with a pinked edge and a pressed border, folded so it has creases (a valley with a shade on one side and a pale line on the other), optionally ringed by a coffee cup. Notes on it are set in the script font, as if in marker.

a11y: A napkin is a plain `div`; use `as="article"` with a label when it means more. The creases, the stain and the pressed border are aria-hidden decoration.
Ink on the napkin is 14:1; the footer 9:1. The creases only shade the paper by a few percent, so they never cost contrast. The tilt is zero in calm density.
meta.usage:
import { Napkin, NapkinContent, NapkinFooter, NapkinTitle } from "@/components/ui/napkin"

<Napkin fold="quarter" stain tape="top">
  <NapkinTitle>Specials</NapkinTitle>
  <NapkinContent>soup of the day, a very small pie</NapkinContent>
  <NapkinFooter>until six</NapkinFooter>
</Napkin>
